title: FINAL COMPUTE, MATERIALIZATION & REPLAY COST COURT
governing_cost_theorem: Rawlsing must pay for the exact empirical distinctions and autonomous-discovery candidate coverage it claims, but it is not semantically required to pay for the current eager V550/V550J artifact suite. Exact result/coverage is binding; physical traversal, precomputation, caching, serialization and search traversal are implementation-contingent.

benchmark_lanes.L3: C02/C03/C04 current cost baseline only; insufficient full-frontier carriers

semantically_unavoidable_costs: exact predicate and risk-set resolution or exact bounded equivalent
same-respondent binding for conditionals, pairs, k-way joints and branch-conditioned facts
exact requested J-way support/mass rather than lower-order marginals
raw support plus governed weight/measure semantics
actor comparator resolution for reverse inference
branch/discovery replay identity and membership/predicate reconstruction
coverage of every candidate included by an explicit autonomous-discovery completeness claim
implementation_contingent_costs: full scan versus accelerated exact lookup
branch member persistence versus deterministic replay

key_cost_laws.unary: T = predicate/risk-set work + target-event grouping; output scales with target response topology
key_cost_laws.conjunction: exact K-coordinate same-respondent composition; independent marginals forbidden
key_cost_laws.pair: same-respondent binding plus exact 2-way cell accumulation; fixed E2 may answer exact fixed pair
key_cost_laws.joint: same-respondent J-way binding plus occupied configuration accumulation; M_J <= min(N_joint, product C_j)
key_cost_laws.autonomous_search: T_search = T_frontier + sum over evaluated candidates T_eval + validation/replay; exhaustive coverage makes F itself a semantic cost axis
key_cost_laws.recursive_search: sum over visited branches of branch-membership/replay plus per-node candidate evaluation on R_b
key_cost_laws.reverse: sum comparator resolution + exact K-conditioner/risk-set work + source-indexed unary/J-way field construction
key_cost_laws.temporal_cross_source: sum exact component replay across waves/universes plus governed comparison/provenance; no default pooling

discovery_cost_coverage.bounded_exhaustive: complete for exact declared frontier; potentially combinatorial candidate count
discovery_cost_coverage.greedy: lower evaluated candidate set; path-local coverage by default
discovery_cost_coverage.beam_adaptive: intermediate cost/coverage; truncation limits coverage absent safe-pruning theorem
discovery_cost_coverage.screen_then_exact: lawful exhaustive claim only if screen has approved no-false-negative guarantee for claimed class
discovery_cost_coverage.recursive: cost follows reached branch state-space; not universal interaction completeness
discovery_cost_coverage.xor_rule: unary-signal pruning cannot preserve exhaustive zero-lower-order-signal/XOR coverage by default
discovery_cost_coverage.minority_rule: cost-driven top-k/support suppression may not turn supported minority into semantic absence

cheap_fail_closed_paths: zero respondent support after exact predicate/risk-set evaluation
reverse_field_frontier.fixed_E2_acceleration: lawful only for exact matching bounded condition/target/risk-set/source/topology/measure identity

materialization_frontier.note: Classifications are semantic cost roles, not cache policy or deletion authority.

asymptotic_high_growth_surfaces: current binary recursive branch candidate evaluation
repeated independent V550 family scans over same question frame
current_exact_formula_examples: recursive candidate bound: sum_d 2^d*(I_q-d) before pruning
cloud all-enabled current pair-attempt bound: Q_cloud*(Q_cloud-1)/2
current V550 checkpoint table writes: 9*Q_exec + 3*Q_cloud + Q_gap

storage_geometry.source_safety: source snapshots remain safety/evidence retention until positive source-to-C11 equivalence and later governance; D14 authorizes no deletion

blocked_measurements.nature: quantitative implementation/runtime sizing unknowns rather than unresolved terminal semantics or physical-information sufficiency

hostile_cost_answers.current_asymptotic_dominators: recursive candidate evaluation and pair/joint/candidate search are steepest in their axes; repeated eager scans/writes add amplification; live wall-clock dominance unknown
hostile_cost_answers.eager_only_costs: broad checkpoint/final serialization, diagnostic/tree/cloud/materialized summary writes and some current shared-cache/revalidation work
hostile_cost_answers.respondent_bound_work: future conjunctions, pairs, k-way joints, branch-conditioned facts, discovery, reverse fields, flexible risk sets and topology-aware replay require deep respondent-event/coordinate access or exact bounded equivalent
hostile_cost_answers.combinatorial_cost: candidate coverage and potential joint state grow with I/Q arity and category products; exact exhaustive declared coverage is semantic, particular scan/traversal strategy is not
hostile_cost_answers.bounded_contingency: may avoid deeper replay only for exact fixed condition/target/risk-set/scope/topology/measure identity
hostile_cost_answers.future_flexibility: forces C11 retention even when most hot queries are cheap/cached
hostile_cost_answers.C11_role: deep exact generator enabling on-demand work and optional bounded caches; no quantified savings or implementation selected
hostile_cost_answers.nonterminal_current_work: diagnostic summaries/E3/E4 and current lossy/superseded interaction/tree/co-signature materializations have no independent terminal justification
hostile_cost_answers.required_future_measurements: populated cardinalities/selectivities, W01-W17 wall/CPU/RSS/I/O/bytes, F/P/H/B distributions, query reuse/cache invalidation, reverse-query arities/no-match rates, source/C11 bytes, concurrency/SLA
